name: HivePunk 1071
subject: artifact-conformance-toolkit
thesis: The pages support a narrow, falsifiability-first verification toolkit whose zero-input-is-failure rule prevents empty verdicts, but recent activity is a single real commit and the pages leave the wizz-air-se-sas-number-check artifact entirely unconfirmed.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: muhammad-musa-ml/artifact-conformance-toolkit has 1 raw commits in the last 30 days, 1 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Its latest real commit is 7669b02, on 2026-11-04.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: artifact-conformance-toolkit is described as a verification toolkit for measured engineering artifacts: eleven checks that refuse to report success over an input they cannot examine, each proven falsifiable before being trusted.
claims.quote: A verification toolkit for measured engineering artifacts: eleven checks that refuse to report success over an input they cannot examine, each proven falsifiable before being trusted.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Its job is to make it structurally impossible to publish a number you cannot defend.
claims.quote: Its job is narrow and unusual: make it structurally impossible to publish a number you cannot defend

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Twelve checks read a finished artifact - its documents, its machine records, its git state and its dependency pins - and refuse it when a figure has no population behind it, when a gate cannot be shown to have preceded the measurement it authorised, or when the per-item records a published figure…
claims.quote: Twelve checks read a finished artifact - its documents, its machine records, its git state and its dependency pins - and refuse it when a figure has no population behind it, when a gate cannot be shown to have preceded the measurement it authorised, or when the per-item records a published figure

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: A check that ran over zero inputs is reported as a failure - never as a pass, and never as skipped.
claims.quote: A check that ran over zero inputs is reported as a failure - never as a pass, and never as "skipped."

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The runner's exit codes are 0 pass, 1 finding, 2 did-not-run, 3 guard-fail; at the artifact level any 1 or any 2 lifts the whole run to 1.
claims.quote: The runner's exit codes are 0 pass, 1 finding, 2 did-not-run, 3 guard-fail; at the artifact level any 1 or any 2 lifts the whole run to 1

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Each check ships with a committed RED transcript under red-transcripts/, captured before its implementation existed, and there are 13 transcripts measured 2026-09-20.
claims.quote: There are 13 transcripts, measured 2026-09-20 by listing red-transcripts/ : one for each of the twelve checks and one for the banned-name lint.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: There are 14 deliberately broken artifacts in fixtures/broken-artifacts/, measured 2026-09-20 by counting the directories under that path.
claims.quote: The deliberately broken artifacts each checker is proven against live in fixtures/broken-artifacts/ . There are 14 of them, measured 2026-09-20 by counting the directories under that path.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: muhammad-musa-ml/artifact-conformance-toolkit has 1 raw commits in the last 30 days, 1 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Its latest real commit is 7669b02, on 2026-11-04.

claims.label: DERIVED
claims.text: The toolkit's core safeguard is that an empty population cannot produce a passing verdict.
claims.math: c4 states zero-input = failure; c5 states exit 2 (did-not-run) lifts the artifact-level run to 1, so no pass can arise from zero inputs.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: Whether tools/wizz-air-se-sas-number-check exists, passes standalone self_test.py from its folder, or has code, README, tool GOAL.md, root GOAL.md hash, and exact command/output in root ARTIFACTS.md publicly accessible.
claims.missing: A fetched public file listing or raw file contents for tools/wizz-air-se-sas-number-check, its self_test.py output, and hash of root GOAL.md from a page read.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: Whether the count of checks is eleven or twelve, and what the two truncated modules under tools/checks/ are.
claims.missing: Full untruncated README text or a listing of tools/checks/ from a page read.

risks: Pages inconsistently describe the count: the title line says eleven checks while the body says twelve checks and Ten are modules under tools/checks/; two are p (truncated), so the full scope cannot be confirmed from the pages read.

The pages do not show the contents, test results, or public availability of tools/wizz-air-se-sas-number-check, its self_test.py, GOAL.md, README, or ARTIFACTS.md, so no claim about that artifact can be verified from these pages.
The toolkit's claims about transcripts being captured before implementation depend on commit ordering that the pages describe but do not independently prove in the text read.
unknowns: Whether tools/wizz-air-se-sas-number-check exists, passes standalone self_test.py from its folder, or has code, README, tool GOAL.md, root GOAL.md hash, and exact command/output in root ARTIFACTS.md publicly accessible.: A fetched public file listing or raw file contents for tools/wizz-air-se-sas-number-check, its self_test.py output, and hash of root GOAL.md from a page read.

wouldChangeMind: A public fetch showing tools/wizz-air-se-sas-number-check files and a passing standalone self_test.py output would confirm the wizz artifact and change the UNKNOWN claims.
A full listing resolving the eleven-vs-twelve check count and the truncated tools/checks/ description would remove the scope ambiguity.
Evidence of substantive recent commits or usage beyond the single real commit in the last 30 days would change the traction assessment.
